E' Nauwi Beach Resort is `a family-friendly beachfront resort located in Eratap, on the island of Efate in Port Vila, Vanuatu`.[[1]](https://www.enauwibeachresort.org/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhsd2VIcDBabTVpGAo)

### Key Details

- **Location:** Situated on the former Aquana Beach Resort site in Eratap, about a 30-minute drive from Port Vila.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/SouthPacificPocketGuide/videos/two-great-resorts-in-eratap-enauwi-beach-resort-and-eratap-beach-resortvanuatuto/1219983193640397/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DQ2OqgHEgQW/)
- **Accommodation:** Features 16 private bungalows facing a calm lagoon and a private offshore island.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/p/E-Nauwi-Beach-Resort-61582134516735/)[[2]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/enauwi-beach-resort)
- **Amenities & Activities:** 
	- On-site restaurant and bar serving Pacific seafood
	- Outdoor swimming pool
	- Spa and wellness center
	- Kids' club, trampoline, bouncy castle, and daily activities/nanny services (8:00 AM – 8:00 PM)
	- Glass-bottom kayaking and boat access to the private island[[1]](https://www.booking.com/hotel/vu/nauwi-beach-resort.html)[[2]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/enauwi-beach-resort)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/p/E-Nauwi-Beach-Resort-61582134516735/)[[4]](https://www.enauwibeachresort.org/)[[5]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhsd2VIcDBabTVpGAo)
- **Getting There:** Arranged airport transfers from Bauerfield International Airport (VLI) cost VUV 2,000 per adult and VUV 1,000 per child (requires 72 hours notice).[[1]](https://www.enauwibeachresort.org/)
- **Contact:** You can reach them at +678 22170 or via the [E' Nauwi Beach Resort Website](https://www.enauwibeachresort.org/).[[1]](https://www.enauwibeachresort.org/)
